articles.availability_note: Catch-up edition: prepared for 2026-11-13; first published November 13, 2026. The November 12, 2026 paper models an electrified system delivering the same useful energy as its 2022 baseline. Its estimated 61% reduction concerns rejected energy; 48% concerns primary energy under a stated accounting convention. This is a stylised counterfactual, with residual fossil uses, rather than a forecast or complete net-zero pathway. Demand growth, detailed reliability, deployment timing and economics remain outside its modelled result.

articles.availability_note: Catch-up edition: prepared for 2026-11-13; first published November 13, 2026. Manchester reported this work on November 12, 2026; the Nature Sensors paper was published September 9. The study reports 34 isolates and a community maintained for 180 days, distinct outcomes rather than 34 new species. Samples came from a South China Sea cold seep at 1,300 metres. Applications and performance beyond the reported conditions remain open. Source images and laboratory protocols are excluded.
